object_prompt: List every separately reconstructable physical object visible in the image, including the white bird toy, orange box, furniture, light stands, cameras, screens, shelves, footwear, and other foreground equipment. Use one concise singular noun phrase per line. Use exactly white bird toy for the white toy and orange box for the orange box. Do not list floor, wall, ceiling, or broad room surfaces: floor is added separately. Do not exclude background objects.

assumptions.scene_scale: explicit unmeasured 0.5 meters/sourceunit; no video calibration
assumptions.floor: single-image MoGe pointmap and actual floor mask; model estimate, no video fitting
assumptions.constitutive_model: one scene-wide jelly law; semantic material sets E/nu/density only
assumptions.background: Every REST3D-reconstructed non-dynamic object remains a static Gaussian asset and is rendered by the Gaussian renderer, not by a 2D mask or image inpainting.
